comingLast.roast: done and dusted on 23 - mostly dusted
the rescue mission: 9 points, 6 holes, no pressure at all
pace of 1.4 - the blue balls have started their walk to the bar
at 1.4 a hole the blue balls fit like they were measured for him
4 to play, 4 to find - the gallery (the bar) is invested
he needs 5 points and a small miracle - the bar has odds on both
the blue balls are patient - 2 holes is nothing to them
in the clubhouse, 1 point of daylight, one nervous eye on the scorers
finished with a 1-point buffer - his group is still reminding him hourly
1 above the cellar door with 1 to play - just keep scoring
